import numpy as np
d=np.load('acts/modin_14.npz')
for k in d.files:
    x=d[k]; print(k, x.shape)
    xc=x[:10]; xg=x[10:]
    mc=xc.mean(0); mg=xg.mean(0)
    v=mc-mg
    # separability: project all onto v direction
    vn=v/ (np.linalg.norm(v)+1e-9)
    pc=xc@vn; pg=xg@vn
    # simple separation metric
    sep=(pc.mean()-pg.mean())/(np.sqrt(pc.var()+pg.var())+1e-9)
